notes: Read all 111 numbered source lines before editing. Coverage: imports ReactNode/lucide ChevronRight/@/lib/cn (L1-3); the CalloutVariant union (L5); the VARIANT_STYLES bg/ring/text/iconText map for info/success/warning/danger (L7-12); the full InlineCalloutProps interface incl. JSDoc on variant/icon/children/action(label,href,onClick)/className/testId (L14-35); the component JSDoc (L37-45); the destructured signature (L46-53); the `const v = VARIANT_STYLES[variant]` lookup (L54); the `content` fragment with the icon span (L57-62), the text-xs flex-1 children span (L63), and the action label + ChevronRight span (L64-69); the baseClass cn() with bg/ring/hover-focus/className (L73-79); the action.href <a> branch (L81-91); the action.onClick <button> branch (L93-104); and the role=status <div> fallback (L106-111).

Source is web/browser-only (rule 4/7): lucide-react ChevronRight (SVG) and the @/lib/cn Tailwind merger have no native parity surface, and the <a>/<button>/<div> DOM elements + className styling do not exist in React Native. Per rule 7 a native-safe implementation was built with no DOM-only modules, Recharts, Leaflet, framer-motion, or web UI components imported.

Behavior/state/prop parity preserved: prop names (variant, icon, children, action{label,href,onClick}, className, testId) and the `v`/`content`/`baseStyle` locals are unchanged; VARIANT_STYLES keeps its name and four keys; the three render branches and their precedence are reproduced exactly — action.href is checked first (href preferred over onClick when both are set), then action.onClick, then the no-action status fallback.

DOM -> RN primitives: the <a href> branch -> Pressable accessibilityRole=link whose onPress calls Linking.openURL(action.href) (the same seam api/devtools.ts uses for window.open); the <button onClick> branch -> Pressable accessibilityRole=button onPress=action.onClick; the role=status <div> -> View with accessibilityLiveRegion=polite + accessibilityRole=text. Linking.openURL is wrapped in .catch(() => undefined) so an unregistered internal route never raises an unhandled rejection; the navigate-on-press affordance and href-over-onClick precedence still hold (documented since internal route hrefs only resolve with a deep-link handler).

icon/children/action.label stay ReactNode-compatible: a renderNode() helper (mirrors EmptyStateThreshold.renderCopy) wraps raw string/number copy in the styled AppText the web <span> supplied and passes caller-supplied native nodes through unchanged. The lucide ChevronRight (h-3 w-3) becomes a decorative '›' AppText glyph at fontSize 12, flagged accessibilityElementsHidden + importantForAccessibility=no-hide-descendants to mirror the web aria-hidden; the icon span's aria-hidden intent is retained via the same decorative treatment when a string glyph is passed.

Visual-intent mapping: Tailwind tints -> shared native tokens. cyan -> colors.accent, emerald -> colors.success, amber -> colors.warning, rose -> colors.danger. The /5 backgrounds (cyan-500/emerald-500/amber-500/rose-500) and /20-/25 rings (cyan-400/emerald-400 at .2, amber-400/rose-400 at .25) are kept as explicit rgba so the subtle tint survives. Body text: info/success --text-secondary -> colors.textSecondary; warning amber-200/85 -> rgba(253,230,138,0.85); danger rose-200/85 -> rgba(254,205,211,0.85) (exact). Icon/action use the variant accent; the web iconText -300 shade collapses to the matching -400 token (one shade more saturated) for token consistency. Layout: inline-flex w-full items-center gap-2 -> flexDirection row, width 100%, alignItems center, gap spacing.sm; rounded-lg -> borderRadius 8; ring-1 -> borderWidth 1; px-3/py-2 -> paddingHorizontal spacing.md / paddingVertical spacing.sm; text-xs -> fontSize 12; flex-1 min-w-0 -> body View flex 1 minWidth 0; the action gap-0.5 font-medium -> gap 2, fontWeight 500.

cn/className + interactive states: React Native has no className, so `className` is retained on props for source compatibility but ignored (destructured as `_className`) and a `style?: StyleProp<ViewStyle>` override is added for native consumers. The web hover:bg-white/[0.03] + focus-visible ring map to a Pressable pressed style (opacity 0.85); the accent focus ring has no native analog and collapses into the pressed feedback. testId -> testID on all three branches. A default export is added to match the sibling feedback ports (BrowserCompatBanner / EmptyStateThreshold).
Gates run from apps/native: npm run typecheck (tsc --noEmit), npm run lint -- --quiet (eslint), npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles (jest).
